name: Harper Mobile Spike
description: Instrumented on-device spike. Engine-free (no WASM). Retains the v0.0.5 settings-vs-note write-eviction protocol (settings writes at t=45s/90s, one known-lethal note write at t=135s) and ADDS a v0.0.6 startup structural probe: whether the .wasm could ship as a SEPARATE .jpl file loaded at runtime from the plugin iframe (XMLHttpRequest and fetch of a file:// URL under installationDir(), plus IndexedDB availability), which would cut the 21 MB inlined bundle back to ~150 KB. Not for publication.
author: pmslava
